title: A machine waiting on full outputs keeps its payout draw across a chunk reload
source: run/TESTING.md §2 出力待ちのままセーブして入り直すと、当たり外れが変わらない; docs/jp/recipes/DECORATORS.md §3 抽選の仕組み (NOTE: 抽選はやり直しません。セーブして入り直しても同じ); ProcessAgent#writeToNBT payoutDecided/payoutSucceeded. The recipe uses chance 1.0, not a value like 0.6: a lost draw ends the run at once and never waits, so the waiting state could not be observed about 4 runs in 10. ChanceRecipeDecorator#producesOutput still draws at 1.0 (unit interval [0,1) < 1.0) and ProcessAgent#payoutSucceeds still records the draw
